critical_boundaries.orbit_count: O2(k) has exactly one diagonal fixed orbit and k off-diagonal two-element orbits, hence |O2(k)|=k+1.
critical_boundaries.coupling_no_go: AA2 gate conditions 1-3 imply a bijection and therefore g_k=k+1; Stage-Z arbitrary-positive-gap freedom supplies allowed same-prefix continuations with g_k!=k+1, so frozen semantics do not establish the coupling.
critical_boundaries.candidate_family: Age/residue candidates are bijective only when the gap already happens to equal k+1; transition-bit state has at most two images and is post-realization.
critical_boundaries.triangular: If a future independent coupling establishes g_k=k+1, then A_k=k(k+1)/2; this remains conditional only.
critical_boundaries.low_n: The shared prefix (a0,a1,a2)=(0,1,1) admits globally extendable a3=1 and a3=2 continuations; no pre-transition current-step discriminator is present.
critical_boundaries.m_slot: |Fm(k)/S_m|=C(k+m-1,m-1) for m=1..4 controls. Two transverse coordinate roles are I0 implementation facts, not an N0 certificate selecting m=2.
critical_boundaries.five: No native 5->4 or 5->9 statement is established; both square and triangular controls remain conditional.
